relevance_note: Case series of five children with LAD-I and ITGB2 variants listed per patient in Table 2 ("ITGB2 mutations were observed in all the patients"), plus a literature table (Table 4) of 9 previously reported LAD-I patients treated with UCBT.
method_note: Read the paper directly; a short Python script assembled the JSON from my transcription of Tables 1-4, and every cell was checked against the tables. Labels: the study's own five patients are numbered 1-5 in Tables 1, 2 and 3 (bare-number 'Patient' column); I used the first table they appear in, 'Table 1 #n', and the same numbering is taken to refer to the same person in Tables 2 and 3. Table 4 (literature UCBT cases, refs 18-20, no per-patient reference column; source_reference_in_review = '(18-20)' from the table title) has 9 numbered rows plus a tenth unnumbered row (14 months, CY + ATG + TBI); the text says the Al-Dhekri patient with engraftment failure received a secondary UCBT after CY + ATG + TBI and the title says 9 patients, so the tenth row was not made a separate person and is noted in the treatment of Table 4 #9 (an interpretation). Table 4 ages are age at UCBT, recorded only in treatment_summary. Engraftment failure / chimerism not recorded as phenotypes. Pre-transplant infections come from Table 2 'Infections'; post-UCBT GvHD grade and complications from Table 3 (marked 'after UCBT' in severity_or_detail). '-' cells in Table 3 are not defined as absent, so Table 1 #3 GvHD and other '-' cells are not reported. 'Intracranial infection' (Table 2, patient 4) was not mapped to the meningitis checklist item; 'urinary tract infection' has no checklist item. Pneumonia mapped to lower respiratory tract infection; intestinal infection to gastrointestinal infections; post-UCBT sepsis (Table 3) counted for sepsis. Group statements without names were not used to exclude (e.g. 'Four of the five patients developed grade II-IV aGvHD'). The onset sentence 'The onset symptom of the other patient was a dental ulcer and gingivitis at the age of one year' does not name the patient (only Table 1 #5 has that infection in Table 2), so onset was left not reported for everyone. Severity: text says one patient had severe LAD-I with 0.8% CD18 (Table 2 shows 0.8% for patient 5) and four moderate (2.4-3.6%); not recorded as a label because the text does not name them; CD18 values recorded per patient as features. Cause of death for Table 1 #4 (the only 'Died' in Table 3): abstract says bronchiolitis obliterans, Results says respiratory failure; both quoted. Contradictions: abstract gives UCBT age range 8 to 32 months, Methods and Table 1 give 8 to 132 months; Results says aGvHD grade II-IV, Discussion says grade II/III while Table 3 lists a grade IV. Zygosity from the Table 2 Zygosity column; variant type, inheritance and pathogenicity not stated per patient.
